brand: Chamra Ghor (a small Dhaka leather workshop)

reader.who: young office workers in Dhaka buying a wallet for themselves or as a gift

facts_given: cow leather from a tannery in Savar
two colours: dark brown and black
the colour darkens a little with use, which is normal for real leather
if a stitch comes loose within 6 months, the workshop repairs it free
voice: everyday Bangla (চলিত), warm and honest, আপনি
